title: A dashboard for a single houseplant
summary: Everything there is to know about one pothos, presented at exactly the scale of the information.

blocks.title: Fernando the pothos, fully monitored
blocks.body: Behold the complete operational picture of one houseplant. It fits on this page because a sticky note would also have fit - so this page is sized like the sticky note.

items.label: Soil, assessed by the highly calibrated index finger
Since last watering - well within pothos tolerance
Water when the top inch of soil is dry
items.detail: Probably Thursday. The finger will know.

items.label: Rotate a quarter turn on watering day
items.detail: So it does not lean into the light like it is eavesdropping.

blocks.title: No further telemetry at this time
blocks.body: There is no moisture sensor, no growth-rate chart, and no trailing twelve-month leaf KPI, because there is one plant and it is fine. The correct dashboard for Fernando was always this size.
